name: Zilko
summary: Credited as the original finder of the legacy Kuldra fight skip (windstep up the floating rocks to the heart). That skip was patched in 1.0.1.2. He has no public videos or comments of his own; only Tiger with the Bars' upload credits him. The SRC account "Zilko" exists but has no runs and may not be the same person. He may be reachable via Discord (".zilko").
